full_page.content:
1933, November
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 159 Cont.
Nov. 8 Miss Genevieve Butler - 35 - cripple, muscles paralized since birth.
8 Alex. McDonald - 43 - fits, quite improved since prayed for in August but had quite bad one last night, promises weekly Com- munion.
Mrs. Eva Strzalwiski - 60 - widow 16 yrs. - cancer of breast & arm.
Agnes Carey - 61 - partial stroke
Mrs. Anna Kunnas - 50 - Lutheran bad cough for 2 yrs. - after fearful examination - 2 weeks unconscious with lungs still bleed- ing. Two doctors said "cancer". 3 said not so. Enrolled To- day for year.
Eliz. Tracy - 54 - fears operation tumor.
Floran Krasneki - 43 - left side like paralysed.
10
Chas Ayers - 55 - Convert - 7 months infected eye .... promises weekly Communion.
Page 160 Nov. 13 Rev. Thomas Kelly - 55 - of Chicago - fearful headaches - 2 masses on Sunday & sermons then sick all week ....
Nellie Stefani - 7 - of Windsor - extremely restless, last year & 6 mo. takes convulsions ...
Chas Browning - 43 - non C. - delerious and pneumonia .... Clarissa C. Mayer of Janesville, Wis. "bewitched".
Rita Gagne- 13 mo's - ruptured Dr's fear formation of abcesses ... (navel).
John Jos Glass - 30 of Buffalo, N.Y. - drinking since Father's death.
14 Helen Venargi - 3 - with T.B. & Paralysis pleads with mother to take her home for Xmas - "Jesus can cure me at home" See Dec. 27. May 16 - Here To-day walking since Easter. O.K.
24 Mrs. Ann McCarthy - 41 - fearful headaches - stomach trouble & fears cancer.
